 169:     def test_04_each_construction_failure_retains_returned_objects(self):
 170:         for phase in ('model_constructor', 'model_prepare', 'pipeline_prepare'):
 171:             with self.subTest(phase=phase), fixture() as f:
 172:                 begin(self, f)
 173:                 self.assertEqual(build(f), {'built': True})
 174:                 b, owner = f.bootstrap, f.bootstrap.registry
 175:                 original = KeyboardInterrupt('generated ' + phase)
 176:                 seen = []
 177:                 target = objects._GeneratedEnginePipeline if phase == 'pipeline_prepare' else objects._GeneratedEngineModel
 178:                 name = '__init__' if phase == 'model_constructor' else 'prepare'
 179: 
 180:                 def fail(value, *args):
 181:                     attempt = owner._engine_attempt
 182:                     self.assertIs(attempt.owner, owner)
 183:                     self.assertIs(attempt.product, owner._product)
 184:                     self.assertEqual(owner._operation[2], 'engine')
 185:                     if phase != 'model_constructor':
 186:                         self.assertIs(value, attempt.pipeline if phase == 'pipeline_prepare' else attempt.model)
 187:                         seen.append(value)
 188:                     raise original
 189: 
 190:                 with replaced(target, name, fail):
 191:                     with self.assertRaises(KeyboardInterrupt) as caught:
 192:                         b._build_generated_engine()
 193:                 self.assertIs(caught.exception, original)
 194:                 attempt = owner._engine_attempt
 195:                 self.assertIs(attempt.failure, original)
 196:                 self.assertIs(attempt.namespace, b._generated_namespace)
 197:                 self.assertIs(attempt.product.vad, b._product)
 198:                 self.assertFalse(attempt.active or attempt.published)
 199:                 self.assertTrue(b._closed and b._quarantined)
 200:                 self.assertFalse(owner._active)
 201:                 self.assertIsNone(owner._operation)
 202:                 if phase == 'model_constructor':
 203:                     self.assertFalse(attempt.model_returned or attempt.pipeline_returned)
 204:                     self.assertIsNone(attempt.model)
 205:                     self.assertIsNone(attempt.pipeline)
 206:                     # No claim to own an object its constructor never returned.
 207:                 elif phase == 'model_prepare':
 208:                     self.assertIs(attempt.model, seen[0])
 209:                     self.assertTrue(attempt.model_returned)
 210:                     self.assertFalse(attempt.pipeline_returned)
 211:                 else:
 212:                     self.assertIs(attempt.pipeline, seen[0])
 213:                     self.assertTrue(attempt.model_returned and attempt.pipeline_returned)
 214:                     self.assertIs(attempt.pipeline.model, attempt.model)
 215:                 b.close_preserving()
 216:                 self.assertIs(owner._engine_attempt, attempt)

 253:     def test_06_secondary_cleanup_failure_preserves_first_error(self):
 254:         with fixture() as f:
 255:             begin(self, f)
 256:             self.assertEqual(build(f), {'built': True})
 257:             b, owner = f.bootstrap, f.bootstrap.registry
 258:             original = KeyboardInterrupt('generated model preparation interrupted')
 259:             calls = []
 260: 
 261:             def fail_model(model):
 262:                 self.assertIs(owner._engine_attempt.model, model)
 263:                 raise original
 264: 
 265:             def failed_revoke(*args):
 266:                 calls.append('owner_revoke')
 267:                 raise RuntimeError('generated revocation unconfirmed')
 268: 
 269:             # Failure injection only: this never returns a forged live/issued
 270:             # answer or bypasses an admission or publication predicate.
 271:             with replaced(objects._GeneratedEngineModel, 'prepare', fail_model):
 272:                 with replaced(owner, 'revoke_generation', failed_revoke):
 273:                     with self.assertRaises(KeyboardInterrupt) as caught:
 274:                         b._build_generated_engine()
 275:             self.assertIs(caught.exception, original)
 276:             self.assertEqual(calls, ['owner_revoke', 'owner_revoke'])
 277:             self.assertGreaterEqual(len(original.__notes__), 2)
 278:             attempt = owner._engine_attempt
 279:             self.assertIs(attempt.failure, original)
 280:             self.assertIsNotNone(attempt.model)
 281:             self.assertIsNone(attempt.pipeline)
 282:             self.assertIs(attempt.product, owner._product)
 283:             self.assertIs(attempt.namespace, owner._namespace)
 284:             self.assertTrue(owner._active)  # Cleanup failure is not revocation credit.
 285:             self.assertFalse(attempt.active or attempt.published)
 286:             self.assertTrue(b._closed and b._quarantined and b._channel._revoked)
 287:             self.assertIsNone(owner._operation)
